inspected_facts: PDF fetched and pdftotext parsed through stdin; no file retained. Four regions and nine geographic state divisions explicitly enumerated. Northeast: New England/Middle Atlantic. Midwest: East/West North Central. South: South Atlantic/East/West South Central. West: Mountain/Pacific. Alaska and Hawaii belong to Pacific division in this source; atlas archipelago convention independently moves Hawaii to Oceania.

Official geographical hierarchy and six geographic provincial/territorial reporting groups: Atlantic, Quebec, Ontario, Prairies, British Columbia, Territories. Geographic regions are groupings of provinces and territories, not literal physical-biome masks.

North America extends from Aleutian Islands to Isthmus of Panama; includes Greenland, Caribbean and western North Atlantic islands. Its five physical regions differ from the atlas reference reporting regions, so do not misdescribe current state/province perimeters as mountain/biome edges.
South America extends from Gulf of Darien to Tierra del Fuego. Andes, Guiana/Brazilian Highlands and transnational Amazon/Orinoco/Parana systems span existing reference reporting regions.

Common atlas demarcation follows Darien Mountains watershed along Colombia-Panama border; independent exact physical crest geometry not supplied. North Atlantic continental convention normally divides Greenland/Iceland and Bermuda/Azores. Falklands continental shelf association documented. Clipperton has North American and Oceanian conventional associations, so choose explicitly.
Remote rainforest, mountains and drainage basin span southern Panama Darien Province and northern Colombia Choco Department. Does not provide exact licensed watershed geometry.

10.300 N, 109.217 W eastern Pacific atoll: 1080km southwest of Mexico, 2424km west of Nicaragua, 2545km west of Costa Rica, 2390km northwest of Galapagos. Closest land Socorro ~945km northwest in Mexican-associated Revillagigedo archipelago. Mainland-geographic Mexico association more defensible than current Central America.
North Atlantic archipelago; nearest external land North Carolina ~1035km west-northwest. Retain Southeastern North America mainland-offshore convention, independent of British ownership.

Greater and Lesser Antilles form Caribbean archipelagos. Lucayan archipelago Bahamas/Turks and Caicos included conventionally even outside Caribbean Sea. Bermuda explicitly excluded, despite CARICOM association.

Eastern Pacific equatorial volcanic archipelago ~898km west of South American mainland. UNESCO region South America; retain mainland-associated western South American geography, not polity-based inference.
Archipelago on Patagonian Shelf ~500km east of southern Patagonian coast. South American association is geographic and independent of sovereignty claims.

Southern Atlantic island geography; associated with South American Atlantic branch as an explicit cartographic exception when Antarctica excluded, not a claim about political ownership or Antarctic physical classification.

Southern Cone definitions vary; traditionally Argentina/Chile/Uruguay, sometimes Paraguay and southern Brazilian states. Retained Southern South America is deliberately broader fixed reporting grouping rather than universally exact Southern Cone.
Botanical reporting scheme at continental/regional/botanical-country/basic-recording levels, designed data interoperability; candidate hierarchy, not independent macro-boundary semantic approval.
Official IBGE locality API enumerates all five geographic macroregions: Norte, Nordeste, Sudeste, Sul, Centro-Oeste.
Official API lists all 26 states plus Federal District, each with exact region id/name. Response decoded from gzip; response data retained in receipt for reproducibility.
Archipelago in northwestern Atlantic Ocean located off the Canadian island of Newfoundland. Association with Northeast North America is geographic, independent of French sovereignty.

Keep all regional interior certificates closed until their separate exhaustive review completes.

groups.convention: Falklands and South Georgia/South Sandwich Islands only. Rename South American Atlantic Islands to distinguish African Atlantic regional group. Explicit South American cartographic association under Antarctica-excluded six-continent convention.
groups.outer_boundary_method: Exact fixed current member-derived land perimeter, modified only by declared native-parent corrections and split crosswalk. Contiguous reference administrative geography and named archipelago conventions are explicit; no political owner field or year determines boundary.
groups.shared_boundary_convention: One canonical member partition on each common reference administrative edge; named offshore/sea domain transitions are associations, not owned ocean geometry. Both neighboring regional workers consume the identical pinned edge and may not shift it independently.
